visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a light gray t-shirt stands before a neutral gray studio background, holding two red INOUI cosmetic containers. He smiles broadly with high energy, looking directly at the camera while moving the products to highlight their vibrant red metallic finish and brand logos. (2) He pumps the red liquid foundation bottle onto the back of his left hand, showing the fluid texture. He then uses his fingers to dab small dots of the product onto his left cheek and forehead with precision while maintaining a friendly expression. (3) Using a small beige cosmetic puff, he rapidly blends the foundation across his face. He turns his head from side to side to demonstrate the natural glow and light-to-medium coverage on his skin under bright, even studio lighting. (4) He presents a red jar of cream foundation to the camera, opening it to reveal a thick, buttery texture. He applies a generous dab to his right cheek, contrasting the side-by-side application process for the viewer's comparison. (5) He blends the cream foundation with the puff, showing its high-moisture finish. He leans in for an extreme close-up to display the fine skin texture and how the cream melts into the pores for a refined, smooth look. (6) He uses a large powder puff to apply translucent setting powder across his entire face. Finally, he holds both products together, comparing the SPF50 liquid side and the SPF30 cream side for the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-energy male voice delivering a fast-paced greeting. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop track with a strong rhythmic guitar strum. The speaker's pitch is high and animated, indicating high arousal and welcoming energy. (2) A sharp plastic 'click' and muffled 'thud' SFX occur at 0:07 as the narrator interacts with the foundation bottle. The BGM remains consistent while the narrator provides technical details about the liquid foundation's texture and light coverage. (3) Rhythmic 'rustling' sounds are audible from 0:21 to 0:30, corresponding to the cosmetic puff hitting the skin. The vocal tone is friendly and conversational, with moderate pitch variability and clear articulation of technical product names. (4) A digital 'pop' SFX at 0:31 marks the transition to the cream foundation segment. The narrator's tone becomes more exaggerated and comedic, describing the 'buttery' sensation with a noticeable increase in vocal intensity and pitch contour. (5) A cinematic 'whoosh' SFX at 0:59 signals the final comparison phase. The narration shifts to a professional, authoritative tone as he lists specific SPF ratings and product benefits, while the BGM continues to provide a steady energetic floor. (6) The speaker delivers a high-arousal closing statement, inviting viewers to choose between the products. The music ends with a clean hard cut, followed by a brief moment of studio silence as the video concludes.
